event.title: SYNTHETIC TEST EVENT (not real)
event.summary: TEST ONLY - synthetic values, not NASA observations. Used for automated tests and UI development.
event.data_label: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA - not NASA observations
event.status_message: Fixture and road extract are available.

disclaimer: This is not a damage assessment. Satellite-observed ground motion does not show whether a road, bridge or structure is damaged; the location is prioritised for human field inspection only.

reason_text.PHASE_MISSING: no unwrapped phase value in the product
reason_text.COHERENCE_MISSING: no coherence value in the product
reason_text.UNWRAP_COMPONENT_ZERO: not assigned to a reliable unwrapped region (connected component 0)
reason_text.PRODUCT_MASK: flagged by the product's own mask layer
reason_text.MODERATE_COHERENCE: coherence between the exclusion and caution thresholds
reason_text.SMALL_COMPONENT: belongs to a small isolated unwrapped region

quality.product_mask_note: product mask decoded as water flag / reference sub-swath / secondary sub-swath: 0 fill, 4640 water and 0 invalid-sample pixels are flagged; 100 pixels carry acquisition anomaly bits and 0 carry the ionosphere-interpolation bit (reported, not excluded)

radar.sign_convention: Positive LOS range change = ground moved away from the satellite along the radar line of sight between the reference (earlier) and secondary (later) acquisition.

reference.description: For zones and ranking, each pixel is compared with a plane fitted to the usable pixels of the same unwrapped region within a 4.1 km window around it, so the values measure motion that differs from the surroundings, not motion shared by the whole area.
reference.scene_description: The motion layer on the map shows LOS range change relative to the median of the same unwrapped region over the whole study area.

threshold.rule: |local LOS range change| >= max(0.03 m, 3 x 1.4826 x MAD)
threshold.note: Screening rule, not a physical truth. The floor and the multiplier were fixed before any real data were inspected; the local reference was adopted after the first real run (see docs/UNCERTAINTY.md).

sensitivity.description: Each weight was perturbed by up to ±20% (one at a time and in 200 seeded random draws), renormalised, and the queue re-ranked.

road_coverage.note: Share of road-crossed pixels with no usable radar observation. These roads are unobserved, not cleared.

corrections.statement: TriageSAR applies no ionospheric, tropospheric or solid-Earth-tide correction to the unwrapped phase. Correction layers listed as available ship with the product and are left untouched.

caveats: Line-of-sight (LOS) range change is a one-dimensional projection of ground motion onto the radar viewing direction. Full 3-D motion is not recovered from a single interferogram.

All values are relative, never absolute displacements, and they are not ground truth. The map colours show motion relative to the median of each unwrapped region in the study area; zones and ranking use the reference described under Methodology.
No ionospheric, tropospheric or solid-Earth-tide correction has been applied by TriageSAR.
Excluded pixels are unobserved, not unmoved. Vegetation, steep terrain, water and rapid surface change reduce radar coherence.
Ground motion is not infrastructure damage. The queue prioritises human field inspection; it is not a substitute for engineering assessment.
